target.title: fix(compaction): avoid cached usage overcount
target.body:
﻿Closes #99843

AI-assisted: Codex.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where long cached Anthropic agent turns could auto-compact far below the configured reserve threshold when the persisted final assistant usage had `totalTokens` missing or zero. In that state, repeated `cacheRead`/`cacheWrite` billing buckets could be summed as if they were one live context-window snapshot, so sessions compacted early and displayed a misleadingly huge token count.

## Why This Change Was Made

The final assistant-message path now carries the latest streamed positive usage `total` onto a cached final usage snapshot when the final message already has provider usage buckets but lacks a trusted `totalTokens`. That preserves the provider's final billing buckets while restoring the real per-call context snapshot needed by compaction. The compaction estimator was simplified back to the canonical rule: use positive `totalTokens` when present, otherwise fall back to the usage buckets for callers that only have a single-call usage snapshot.

## User Impact

Users running long cached tool-loop sessions should no longer see safeguard compaction fire early just because cached prompt billing buckets were counted repeatedly across calls. Sessions with a real cached context above the reserve threshold still compact, because the streamed total is preserved before the estimator reads the assistant message.

## Evidence

- Current PR head: `f38d6681d51bef4050e4cc5cc4cf09ffdbdd57c5`.
- Redacted runtime transcript using production `preservePendingAssistantUsage`, `estimateContextTokens`, `calculateContextTokens`, and `shouldCompact`:

```console
$ node --import tsx %TEMP%/openclaw-99843-runtime-proof.ts
{"label":"issue-99843-redacted-cached-turn","persistedTotalTokens":163978,"persistedCacheRead":819661,"persistedCacheWrite":93130,"directContextTokens":163978,"trailingTokens":3225,"estimatedTokens":167203,"threshold":180000,"shouldCompact":false}
{"label":"above-threshold-cached-turn","persistedTotalTokens":190000,"persistedCacheRead":819661,"persistedCacheWrite":93130,"directContextTokens":190000,"trailingTokens":3225,"estimatedTokens":193225,"threshold":180000,"shouldCompact":true}
```

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot` -> 1 file, 6 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-core.config.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot` -> 1 file, 44 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/agent-harness.ts src/agents/sessions/agent-session.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.test.ts` -> passed.
- `git diff --check -- packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/agent-harness.ts src/agents/sessions/agent-session.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.test.ts` -> passed.
